## Owner-assigned split

The Mac product pair completes one bounded change, necessary local verification, exact
version freeze and normal remote publication, then hands off and stops. The Windows group
owns actual AI early-HTML behavior verification and the final run. Windows behavior checks
are not an additional Mac rehearsal gate. Windows runtime facts and final-run mode are
settled before Windows execution, not before this local product documentation work.

## Product requirements

1. Preserve the current early-view rule: after basic facts and an initial plan, the AI
   starts the correct workspace's existing read-only HTML service, opens or links its
   actual URL, guides the human and waits for explicit page-visible confirmation.
   Before confirmation, only view access and record upkeep proceed. Use existing records
   to retain a same-task confirmation across continuation. Page confirmation grants no
   spending, DNS or deletion authority.
2. Reconcile affected product descriptions and decision records with that rule. Keep
   documentation claims tied to the evidence actually available for this release. No
   claim of validated Windows operation or verified AI compliance follows from static
   instruction checks or passing local automated tests.
3. Keep the existing state/event model, local read-only view and approval semantics.
   Check existing functionality before proposing changes. A further implementation fix
   requires a reproducible, relevant product issue and a declared bounded correction;
   do not infer a runtime defect from missing external measurement evidence.
4. Produce the exact source commit, version identifier, changed-file list, validation
   record and tested command instructions for the Windows group. Declare target-runtime
   prerequisites and unverified Windows behavior honestly, without inventing results.

## Local verification and independent acceptance

The fresh product Executor declares actual tools/worktree and a finite plan. The fresh
independent product Reviewer checks the changed instructions against product semantics
and verifies relevant local checks. Existing tests should cover touched behavior; do not
add tests merely to mirror text. Report prerequisites or failures as observed. No new
cloud deployment, multi-session AI rehearsal or platform matrix is part of Mac close.

Actual early-HTML AI startup, guidance, waiting and same-task continuation remain
UNVERIFIED until Windows records those behaviors. Mac acceptance is local product-change
acceptance only and must state that limit.

## Concrete initial change boundary

Preserve and review the three pending changes. Reconcile only directly affected text in
README.md, skills/router.md, skills/stages/plan.md, docs/architecture.md and
docs/design-decisions.md. Ensure the early-view invocation rule, plan/action approvals,
same-task continuation and validation claims agree. The existing runtime/schema need
no speculative redesign. No newly reproduced product defect is supplied by this task.

If a relevant check demonstrates a product defect, report its reproduction, evidence,
minimum proposed correction and affected files in the candidate plan. Reviewer may
approve a finite correction inside the existing product semantics. A change to state
ownership, view write capability, approval authority, mode semantics or project scope
returns to Human Operator before implementation. Do not silently expand into platform engineering.

For documentation-only changes, run git diff --check and the existing affected
skills/documentation/workflow tests. Broaden to other existing tests only for a demonstrated
dependency or implementation change. Browser prerequisites must be reported if required;
no new dependency install or AI rehearsal is authorized by this entry. Keep runtime
evidence separate from instruction consistency checks.

## Publication preparation

Organization: helmls-studio. Local root: <CLIENT_HOME>/Desktop/helmls-studio.
The root helmls-studio repository contains program documents only; publish the product
as an independent repository. Candidate product repository: helmls-studio/watchover-ai-devops.
Exact repository, creation authorization, branch and visibility must be settled before
remote actions. Keep normal publication distinct from repository creation or visibility
changes; no force-push authorization exists. Product publication excludes private runtime
records, credentials and custody artifacts.

## Context and completion boundary

New product actors use product source and a neutral product-only entry. Previous
experimental-preparation actors do not continue as product builders in their old sessions.
The product entry records the Owner-directed early-view requirement as the current
invocation rule; it must not also instruct the human to launch the view as a requirement.

Mac completion requires independent acceptance of the bounded change, a pinned version,
normal publication to the settled target, and a Windows handoff that lists remaining
behavioral verification. It does not imply Windows success or final-run acceptance.

## Preserved product semantics and Owner invocation update

One bounded current state and append-only event history; seven existing fact statuses;
local, read-only, self-refreshing English view; no secrets in records or publication;
human approvals in the AI session at existing action boundaries. Current product mode
remains basic. No new reviewer-controlled product mode is part of this task.

The current Owner rule makes the AI start and introduce the view and wait for explicit
same-task page confirmation. Historical human-launch/no-view-dependency wording has
been superseded for future product use. The view remains read-only and page confirmation
does not grant action approval. Actual AI behavior verification belongs to Windows;
Mac checks instruction consistency and the concrete product change.

## Authority and output locations

Executor owns product changes, checkpoints and rounds/r<N>_PLAN.md,
rounds/r<N>_EXEC_SUBMISSION.md. Reviewer owns rounds/r<N>_PLAN_REVIEW.md and
rounds/r<N>_REVIEW.md only; never fixes product files. Each role artifact is create-once.
Both may update STATUS.md only with current routing and locators to their own results;
Operations Coordinator owns the canonical UserOps ledger. No role writes another role's artifacts.

Use fresh product-only sessions. Declare actual identity/model/session/tools/permissions;
filesystem access must be real, not assumed. Product Executor Actor 01 and
Reviewer Actor 02 are assigned role identities; host models are declared
by the actors. Cross-family independence is required. Old experimental-preparation
contexts are not resumed for product design/build.

No cloud, DNS, credentials, Docker, tool install, root-program-repo commit, new GitHub
repository, visibility change, force-push or remote write in the current local release.
Normal product publication direction is retained; exact target and publication gate
are settled separately. This must not block authorized local work.

## Workflow

1. Both roles enter fresh, read agent.md loadout and declare full EXEC_ACK/REVIEW_ACK,
   actual tools/session/model, independence and product branch/HEAD/worktree. Operations Coordinator's
   observed environment is not a substitute for actor checks.
2. Executor inspects the existing three changes and submits a short finite plan in
   rounds/r1_PLAN.md: files, proposed changes, why needed, relevant checks, acceptance
   limits and stop point. Before plan acceptance, product access is read-only. Update
   STATUS.md to NEXT=REVIEWER_PLAN.
3. Reviewer independently checks the plan and baseline, publishes
   rounds/r1_PLAN_REVIEW.md and updates current state. A scoped plan PASS routes to
   Executor implementation under this existing Owner local authorization. A blocker or
   authority/scope conflict returns to Human Operator. Do not require another whole-task approval.
4. Executor implements only the accepted finite plan, preserves Owner's pending changes,
   runs change-appropriate existing checks, performs Charter self-verification, then
   writes rounds/r1_EXEC_SUBMISSION.md with exact diff/files/evidence/pins and updates
   STATUS.md to NEXT=REVIEWER. No automatic adjacent cleanup or broad feature work.
5. Reviewer reads actual changed files and raw relevant check evidence. Publish a complete
   finite findings set for the in-scope pass, not one issue per round. Use new r<N> files
   for targeted rework. Never edit Executor product or submissions.
6. After independent local PASS, Executor may create the exact local product checkpoint
   and record its commit SHA/version; Reviewer binds acceptance to that exact tree/ref.
   Submit the Mac handoff and publication-ready file list. Actual remote publication
   awaits a concrete external-release decision; Windows behavior remains unverified.

## Success and limits

Affected product docs agree on AI-managed early-view entry, same-task explicit
confirmation, ordinary approvals and the evidence actually established for this release.
Relevant local checks pass or have a named observed blocker. A pinned product candidate
and Windows handoff identify what was checked locally and what Windows must still check.
No new AI HTML rehearsal, final experiment or broad portability matrix occurs on Mac.

No previously issued live-action authority is reused. No product-value, Windows-runtime
or actual AI-compliance claim follows from local/static acceptance. Product/runtime
defects need concrete reproduction; authority/semantics changes return to Human Operator.

## Workspace lease

Only Executor writes product files on the observed main worktree. Recheck current HEAD
and worktree before mutation; retain the three initial Owner changes. Reviewer has
VerifyOnly product access and writes only its designated role artifacts/current routing.
The product write lease ends at final local submission and checkpoint/handoff; reopening
after freeze requires a new concrete defect and Owner direction. Do not reset, clean,
bulk-stage unrelated changes or modify the parent program repository.
